institution_waivers.note: For Educational Technology/Introductory Technology requires: (a) NCE Merit in Arabic, Christian Religious Studies, English Language, Fine and Applied Arts, French, History, Islamic Studies or Nigerian Languages, or any three relevant subjects in IJMB/JUPEB; (b) NCE Merit in Biology, Chemistry, Computer Science, Health Education, Human Kinetics, Integrated Science, Mathematics, Physics, Technology Education, and ND Lower Credit in A-V Technology, Electrical/Mechanical/Civil Engineering/Woodwork/Metallurgical, Computer Science or Mass Communication; (c) NCE Merit in Accounting, Economics, Geography, Political Science or Social Studies.
